limitations: Observed historical industry aggregate, not a 2026 carrier observation or matched used Cascadia/dryvan53 small-fleet maintenance estimate.
Routine lubrication included as an explicit planning interpretation of all maintenance, not a separately measured rate or empirically confirmed survey microcategory. Do not add an oil price on top.
Different maintenance/tyre/population source alternatives remain visible; tyres retain their prior TTI rate and DEF remains an operating-fluid input. This is not one jointly observed cohort.
No homogeneous net-tax basis, VAT increment, inflation escalation or guaranteed conservative bound is inferred.
Bonus averages cover recipients, not all drivers. Neither carrier prevalence nor published average determines pilot eligibility, staffing or fixed/variable allocation.
Employer charges, workers compensation, wait compensation and other driver scope remain unresolved. Federal tax rules do not prove the ATRI benefit aggregate already includes or excludes each tax.
